subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` fail closed unless the active model provider is xAI, including when active-model metadata is missing, or should cross-provider use remain available behind an explicit opt-in?
rationale: This fixes a credential-backed billing boundary, but it intentionally changes provider/tool availability for existing cross-provider workflows and missing-metadata runtime paths.

options.title: Require active xAI model by default
options.body: Keep the PR's fail-closed policy, add factory tests and docs, and treat intentional cross-provider xAI tool use as future explicit opt-in work.

options.title: Add explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Preserve the fail-closed default but add a documented config or tool policy path for operators who intentionally want xAI-billed tools under non-xAI models.

options.title: Pause for broader provider-tool policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define one common policy for provider-billed server-side tools across xAI and future provider integrations.

recommendation.title: Require active xAI model by default
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's fail-closed policy, add factory tests and docs, and treat intentional cross-provider xAI tool use as future explicit opt-in work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the active-model plugin context and has recent history on the relevant provider/plugin boundary used by this decision.
